fullPassage: A recent study showed that many technological devices and systems are designed not only to carry out certain tasks but also to reassure users that they are functioning properly. One example of this is how some internet voice calling apps feature fake static noise. This noise actually helps put callers at ease because a completely noise-free connection can make some think that the call has been dropped. Such features are not new to the digital age, though. When the 1ESS (Number One Electronic Switching System) telephone system was introduced in the 1960s, calls would sometimes fail to properly connect. When this happened, the system would send the call to a completely different person, leading the caller to believe that they had dialed the wrong number. Unaware of the technical failure, they would simply hang up and try calling again. While this may seem deceptive, it helped prevent user frustration and maintain public confidence in the effectiveness of the new technology.

Safety is a key feature of the new car.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 feature가 (A)와 같은 의미로 쓰인 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 feature는 '특징으로 하다/포함하다'(동사). 1번도 같은 동사 용법.
det.analysis:
✅ ① feature(동사: 특징으로 다루다/포함하다): 잡지가 기사를 '특집으로 다루다' — (A)와 같은 동사 용법 ← 정답
❌ ② feature(명사: 이목구비/특징): '그녀의 가장 좋은 특징'이라는 명사 용법
❌ ③ feature(명사/형용사: 장편): feature film(장편 영화)이라는 수식 용법
❌ ④ feature(명사: 특징/기능): '핵심 특징'이라는 명사 용법
det.tip: feature 동사 = ~을 특징으로 하다/포함하다 vs 명사 = 특징/이목구비

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the quality of being certain that something will work well or that you can trust someone or something"

det.korean: 어떤 것이 잘 작동하거나 누군가/무언가를 신뢰할 수 있다는 확신의 자질 → confidence(신뢰, 확신).
det.analysis:
❌ ① frustration(좌절/불만): 부정적 감정으로, 확신/신뢰와 무관
❌ ② failure(실패/고장): 작동 실패를 뜻하므로 정의와 반대
❌ ③ connection(연결): 물리적 연결이지 심리적 확신이 아님
✅ ④ confidence(신뢰/확신): '잘 작동할 것이라는 확신' 정의에 정확히 부합 ← 정답

questions.passage: Many technological devices and systems are designed not only to carry out certain tasks but also to reassure users that they are __________ (function) properly.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 기기들이 제대로 '작동하고' 있다고 안심시킨다. function → functioning (현재분사, are + -ing 진행형).
det.analysis:
are __________ properly 구조에서 be동사 + V-ing 진행형이 필요. function → functioning.
구문: they are functioning properly (그것들이 제대로 작동하고 있다)
det.tip: be + V-ing = 진행형. function(작동하다) → functioning(작동하고 있는)

questions.passage: When the 1ESS telephone system was __________ (introduce) in the 1960s, calls would sometimes fail to properly connect.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 1ESS 전화 시스템이 1960년대에 '도입되었을' 때. introduce → introduced (과거분사, 수동태 was + p.p.).
det.analysis:
was __________ in the 1960s 구조에서 수동태 be + p.p.가 필요. introduce → introduced.
구문: the system was introduced (시스템이 도입되었다) — 수동태

questions.passage: A recent study showed that many technological devices and systems are designed not only to carry out certain tasks but also to reassure users that they are functioning properly. One example of this is how some internet voice calling apps feature fake static noise. This noise actually helps put callers __________ because a completely noise-free connection can make some think that the call has been dropped. Such features are not new to the digital age, though. When the 1ESS (Number One Electronic Switching System) telephone system was introduced in the 1960s, calls would sometimes fail to properly connect. When this happened, the system would send the call to a completely different person, leading the caller to believe that they had dialed the wrong number. Unaware of the technical failure, they would simply hang up and try calling again. While this may seem deceptive, it helped prevent user frustration and maintain public confidence in the effectiveness of the new technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 잡음이 발신자들을 '안심하게' 만들어준다(put callers at ease).
det.analysis:
❌ ① at risk(위험에 처한): 안심시키는 맥락과 정반대
❌ ② in charge(담당하는, 책임지는): 발신자가 담당자가 되는 맥락이 아님
✅ ③ at ease(편안하게, 안심하여): 잡음이 발신자를 '안심시킨다'는 본문의 put callers at ease와 일치 ← 정답
❌ ④ in danger(위험에 빠진): 안심과 반대
det.tip: put ~ at ease = ~를 안심시키다, 편안하게 하다

questions.passage: A recent study showed that many technological devices and systems are designed not only to carry out certain tasks but also to reassure users that they are functioning properly. One example of this is how some internet voice calling apps feature fake static noise. This noise actually helps put callers at ease because a completely noise-free connection can make some think that the call has been dropped. Such features are not new to the digital age, though. When the 1ESS (Number One Electronic Switching System) telephone system was introduced in the 1960s, calls would sometimes fail to properly connect. When this happened, the system would send the call to a completely different person, leading the caller to believe that they had dialed the wrong number. Unaware of the technical failure, they would simply hang up and try calling again. While this may seem deceptive, it helped prevent user frustration and maintain __________ in the effectiveness of the new technology.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 새 기술의 효과에 대한 '대중의 신뢰'를 유지하는 데 도움이 되었다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① private ownership(개인 소유): 소유권이 아니라 신뢰 유지가 주제
✅ ② public confidence(대중의 신뢰): maintain 뒤에서 새 기술에 대한 '대중의 신뢰'를 유지한다는 결론부 맥락에 부합 ← 정답
❌ ③ general confusion(일반적 혼란): 혼란을 유지하는 것이 아님, 방지하려는 맥락
❌ ④ technical knowledge(기술 지식): 지식이 아니라 신뢰의 유지가 핵심
det.tip: public confidence = 대중의 신뢰 (maintain + in the effectiveness)
